title: Total sum & average
question: Compute total sum of all elements and average using index loops.
initialCode:
mat = [[1,2],[3,4]]
s = 0
rows = len(mat)
cols = len(mat[0])
for i in range(0, rows, 1):
    for j in range(0, cols, 1):
        s += mat[i][j]
print(s)
print(s / (rows * cols))

title: Row averages
question: Compute average of each row and print a list of averages.
initialCode:
mat = [[1,2],[3,4]]
avgs = []
for i in range(0, len(mat), 1):
    s = 0
    for j in range(0, len(mat[0]), 1):
        s += mat[i][j]
    avgs.append(s / len(mat[0]))
print(avgs)

title: Small convolution-like sum
question: For each element, compute its value plus right neighbour (if exists) and print new matrix of same shape (use 0 when neighbour missing).
initialCode:
mat = [[1,2],[3,4]]
out = [[0,0],[0,0]]
for i in range(0, len(mat), 1):
    for j in range(0, len(mat[0]), 1):
        right = mat[i][j+1] if j+1 < len(mat[0]) else 0
        out[i][j] = mat[i][j] + right
print(out)
